## Summary and General Analysis
- Asta gains a stack of "Charging" for every different enemy hit by Asta. She gains 2 stacks if hitting an enemy with Fire Weakness. Each stack of "Charging" increases the team's ATK, up to 5 stacks. From her second turn onward, 3 stacks of "Charging" are removed.

## Noteable Investments
 ### E4 > E1 = E6
- E4 boosts Ultimate uptime.
- E1 and E6 boost "Charge" uptime.
